calculation.expression: median({r_j,t}: j != i, valid peers) for asset i
calculation.description: At each date, use the cross-sectional median one-day return of all other tradable benchmark assets as the signal for asset i. This interpretable lead-lag spillover factor captures broad peer shock transmission without using the asset's own contemporaneous return in its signal. Signals are formed using data through t and evaluated on t+1.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across reported regimes: 2020-2022 IC 0.05968 (ICIR 0.1780), 2023-2024 IC 0.04560 (0.1405), 2025-2026 IC 0.05189 (0.1530), and 2026-07 through 2027-02 IC 0.02440 (0.0841). Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. A few constant-signal dates generated undefined rank correlations and were excluded by pandas aggregation; the reported 4,152 observations are the script's valid-date count before NaN omission and should be audited downstream.
